title: Canon of the Searing Lance
summary: A canon on drawing light into a hot straight shaft that bores through guards and falls in a rain of small lances.

title: Treatise on the Lamp Ward
summary: A treatise on the lamp of light that guards the wounded and calls back a stopped breath within a short window.

title: The Open Sky Radiance Canon
summary: A canon on spreading the qi field wide as a plain of light that burns and guards and senses past arm's reach.

title: Manual of the Dawn Reckoning
summary: A court manual of exact and measured strokes of light that mark a target first and strike the mark at once.

title: The Prism Court Treatise
summary: A treatise on splitting the qi field into many beams and joining them again to strike from every side at once.

title: A Compendium of Truthful Light
summary: A compendium on a light that shows what is held in qi and in the body and burns false glimmers from the air.

title: Manual of the Far Horizon Beam
summary: A manual of long beams and long strides that keep a fighter in the open where a light user is strongest.

title: The Oath of Clear Sight
summary: A manual of the sworn open eye that hides nothing and lets no hidden thing near; the light of the field is its guard.

title: Treatise on Cleansing Radiance
summary: A treatise on a field of clean light that burns taint from the blood and calls back a breath just stopped.
